pub struct Table<'data> { values: &'data [u32] }
impl<'data> Table<'data> {
    pub fn new(values: &'data [u32]) -> Self { Table { values } }
    pub fn enumerate(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (usize, &'data u32)> {
        self.values.iter().enumerate()
    }
    pub fn values(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32> + 'data {
        self.values.iter().copied()
    }
    pub fn callback<'a>(&self, x: &'a u32) -> impl Fn() -> u32 + 'a { move || *x }
}
pub fn equivalent<Q: PartialEq>(key: &Q) -> impl Fn(&Q) -> bool + '_ {
    move |value| key == value
}
pub fn const_array<const N: usize>() -> impl AsRef<[u8]> { [3u8; N] }
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! make_iterator {
    () => {
        fn iterator<'a>(values: &'a [u32]) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a u32> {
            values.iter()
        }
    };
}
